important_topics: Types of solutions — solid in liquid, gas in liquid, liquid in liquid

previous_year_questions: In a solution 30 mass percent of benzene is dissolved in carbon tetrachloride. Calculate mole fraction of benzene. [2025 Set-1]
Explain Raoult's Law. [2025 Set-1]

The vapour pressure of pure benzene at any temperature is 0.850 bar. 0.5 g non-volatile non-electrolytic solid dissolved in 39.0 g benzene. Vapour pressure becomes 0.845 bar. Calculate molar mass of solid. [2025 Set-2]
What is relation between elevation of boiling point and molality? [2025 Set-3]
Define Raoult's law. Establish expression for calculating molar mass of solute on basis of this law. [2024 Set-3]

Explain reason for depression in vapour pressure. At any temperature vapour pressure of pure solvent is 0.745 bar. 0.5 g non-volatile non-electrolyte dissolved in 39.0 g solvent (mol mass 78 g/mol). VP = 0.740 bar. Find molar mass of solid. [2024 Set-3]
Define osmotic pressure. Establish relation with molar mass of solute. [2024, 2023]
What is relation between depression in freezing point and molar mass of solute? [2024 Set-4]
54% water is present in mixture of ethyl alcohol and water. Calculate mole fraction of ethyl alcohol and water. [2024 Set-5]
key_mcq_answers: Colligative properties depend on number of solute particles, not on nature
Colligative properties: relative lowering of VP, elevation of BP, depression of FP, osmotic pressure
Osmotic pressure is directly proportional to concentration: π = CRT
Van't Hoff factor i > 1 for dissociation (electrolytes)
Van't Hoff factor i < 1 for association
Henry's law: solubility of gas in liquid increases with increase in pressure
Gaseous solution example: O₂ dissolved in water, H₂ in palladium
Positive deviation from Raoult's law: A-B interactions weaker than A-A or B-B
key_fill_blanks: K_f (cryoscopic constant) for water = 1.86 K kg mol⁻¹
K_b (ebullioscopic constant) for water = 0.512 K kg mol⁻¹
Depression in FP formula: ΔT_f = K_f × m

Molar conductance (Λ_m) increases with dilution

SI unit of specific conductance κ = S cm⁻¹ or S m⁻¹

Strong electrolytes: conductance increases linearly with √C (Kohlrausch)
Weak electrolytes: Λ_m increases sharply near zero concentration

key_mcq_answers: In IUPAC nomenclature: ligands named before metal ion

Anionic ligands end in '-o': chloro, cyano, oxalato, hydroxo
Coordination number = number of donor atoms attached to central metal

[Ni(CN)₄]²⁻: square planar, dsp² hybridisation, diamagnetic
[NiCl₄]²⁻: tetrahedral, sp³ hybridisation, paramagnetic

Rank 17: Write chemical equations of preparation of diazonium salt and write four chemical reactions of benzene diazonium chloride (Sandmeyer, coupling, etc.). - Amines (5 marks, 2025, 2024, 2023)

important_formula_sheets.note: Direct formulas aur expressions fill in blank aur short answer mein puchhe jaate hain. Formula sheet exam mein allowed nahi.

formulas: Elevation of BP: ΔT_b = K_b × m
Depression of FP: ΔT_f = K_f × m
Molar mass from FP depression: M₂ = (K_f × w₂ × 1000) / (ΔT_f × W₁)
Molar mass from osmotic pressure: M = wRT / (πV)
Relative lowering of VP: (p° - p)/p° = χ_solute
Van't Hoff factor: i = (observed colligative property) / (calculated without dissociation)
Nernst equation: E_cell = E°_cell - (0.0591/n) log Q  at 298K
ΔG° = -RT ln K  →  log K = nE°/0.0591  at 298K
Molar conductance: Λ_m = (κ × 1000) / C(mol/L)  or  κ/C(mol/m³)
Faraday's first law: m = (M / nF) × I × t = (M × I × t) / (n × 96500)

practical_paper.practical_exam_note: Practical of 30 marks conducted separately. Separate passing required in theory (23/70) and practical (10/30).

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: Medium to Difficult. 7 sets. Level almost same across sets.
most_scoring_sections: Easy to Medium — clear concepts needed. Some tricky options.
most_difficult_sections: Moderate to Difficult — theoretical knowledge tested, equations must be given.
Moderate to Difficult — multi-part answers, includes numericals.
Moderate to Difficult — application-based, numericals, answered in parts (2+2 or 1+1+1+1).
Application-based — mostly organic chemistry — reaction and tests asked. Good grip on reactions needed.

tips: Chemical equations are compulsory wherever asked — every equation can fetch 1 mark individually
Q6 and Q7 (5 marks each) = 20 marks — prepare at least 8 standard organic reactions topics
OR choices in Q6-Q7: always pick the option you know MORE reactions/equations for
Organic chemistry dominates 5-mark questions — focus: haloalkanes, alcohols, phenols, amines, carboxylic acids
For mechanisms (SN1, SN2, aldol, nucleophilic addition) — draw the transition state or intermediate clearly
Numerical questions: always write 'Given:', 'Formula:', 'Calculation:', 'Answer with unit:'
For short notes (3 marks): write name + definition + chemical equation for each reaction
IUPAC nomenclature of coordination compounds — practice naming thoroughly — 2 marks per compound
Biomolecules: carbohydrates classification comes every year as 5-mark — must prepare
No negative marking — attempt ALL questions compulsorily
Give chemical equations wherever necessary — this instruction appears in every paper

time_allocation.note: Read all questions. Decide all OR choices in Q6 and Q7. Check which 4-mark part you can score best in Q5.
6 MCQs x 1.5 min. Write only the correct option letter. Do not waste time here.
8 questions x 3-4 min each. 4-6 lines answer. Write chemical equation wherever possible.
4 sub-questions x 8-9 min each. Include equations. Multi-part answers.
4 sub-questions x 10 min each. Application-based. Show steps in numericals.
4 long answers x 11 min each. Chemical equations compulsory. Write mechanism steps.
Check all chemical equations written. Balance missing equations. Check numerical units.

targets.strategy: Q1 MCQ (6) + easy 2-mark questions from Solutions, Biomolecules (8-10) + 1-2 three-mark answers (3-6) = 17-22 marks. One good 5-mark organic answer = 5 bonus.
focus_areas: Q1 MCQ — attempt all 6 (no negative marking). Know: colligative properties, electrode potential, rate constant units, carbylamine test, vitamins.
2-mark questions: Raoult's law, molarity definition, explain Tollen's/Fehling's test, lanthanoid contraction, coordination number
3-mark: Factors affecting rate of reaction (concentration, temperature, catalyst) — comes every year
5-mark: Carbohydrates classification — straightforward, theory-based, every year
chapters_to_skip_safely: Mechanism of SN1/SN2 reactions if not prepared

targets.strategy: Q1 (6) + Q2-Q3 two-marks 6-7 questions (12-14) + Q4 three-marks 3-4 parts (9-12) + Q5 four-marks 2 parts (8) + Q6-Q7 one 5-mark answer (5) = 40-45.
focus_areas: Solutions: Raoult's law, osmotic pressure numerical, elevation of boiling point
Electrochemistry: molar conductivity numerical, Faraday's law numerical
Chemical kinetics: factors affecting rate (3 marks), first order numerical
d-f block: transition metal properties, lanthanoid contraction
5-mark organic: carbohydrates classification OR carbylamine/Hoffmann/Schmidt short notes

targets.strategy: Q1 (6) + Q2-Q3 full (16) + Q4 full (12) + Q5 full (16) + Q6-Q7 two 5-mark answers (10) = 60 marks.
focus_areas: All 3-mark and 4-mark derivations prepared with equations
Organic chemistry 5-mark: prepare 5-6 standard long answers (SN1/SN2, phenol reactions, amine reactions, carbohydrates)
Numericals: Raoult's law, osmotic pressure, molar conductivity, Nernst equation, first order kinetics

answer_sheet_rules: question_number_note: Haan — har answer ke upar question number likhna zaroori hai. Examiner dhundhta hai. Nahi likha toh marks confusion ho sakta hai.
set_number_note: Haan — apna set number (JS/JT/JU/JV/JW etc.) answer sheet ke cover page par compulsory likhna hota hai.
question_copy_note: Answer sheet mein poora question likhna zaroori nahi. Sirf question number likho aur answer shuru karo.
rough_work: Answer sheet ka last page rough work ke liye. Clearly ROUGH WORK likho. Rough work pe marks nahi milte lekin kaam aata hai.
supplementary_sheet: Supplementary sheet lene se marks nahi katenge. Zaroorat ho toh lo. Lekin unnecessary blank pages waste mat karo.
sequence_note: Questions ka sequence follow karna zaroori nahi. Jo aata ho pehle karo. Lekin question number clearly likho.
last_to_first: Haan — paper last se bhi start kar sakte ho. Koi rule nahi ki sequence follow karo.
long_answer_position: Long answers (Section D aur E) hamesha paper ke last mein nahi hote. Jo bhi section easy lage pehle karo.
section_name_before_section: Section ka naam likhna compulsory nahi lekin recommended hai. Examiner ko navigate karna easy hota hai.
line_after_each_question: Zaroori nahi. Lekin do lines draw karne se answer clearly separate dikhta hai — good practice.
cutting_overwriting: Cuts se marks directly nahi katenge. Ek clean line se kato. Clean cutting acceptable hai.
short_before_long: Pehle short answers attempt karo phir long — marks nahi katenge. Jo bhi order suit kare.
sub_questions: Sub questions matlab ek question ke andar (a), (b), (c), (d) parts hote hain. Har part ke marks alag alag hote hain.

pen_rules.note: Blue pen se main answer, black se headings/underline. Ya sirf ek color bhi chalega.

exam_writing_rules.rough_work_rules: Answer sheet ka last page rough work ke liye. Clearly ROUGH WORK likho. Rough work pe marks nahi milte lekin kaam aata hai.
